reply.text:
A rapid cut in three days is where people get hurt and fight badly, and the amounts of fluid or food to cut are a call for a doctor or a dietitian who works with combat athletes, not me. I won't hand out a water-loading or dehydration plan.

What I can say in general terms is that the people who make weight and still perform are the ones who ask how far off they are: a small gap is handled with normal eating and a few small adjustments, while a big gap in three days usually means moving up a class, or checking whether you can weigh in closer to the match. Keep training easy and sharp this week, sleep well, and don't try anything new on tournament day.

If you tell me how far you are from the limit, I can talk through the training side with you, like how to keep the last few sessions light so you arrive fresh.
